cards.title: Current Figure 1 draft v16
cards.difference: Accepted F–H V12 values and bright blue–charcoal–red palette. Display rows 1–90; F arrows mark 5, 13, 59, 62, 89. Native DejaVu Sans text; G is labelled 3sTrace.
cards.notes: Current presentation draft; no whole-figure formal freeze.
cards.legend:
(F–H) Example heatmaps for Delay (20221115_07), 3 s Trace (20230310_08) and Control (20221115_09). Vigor is calculated from distal angular speed using the specified movement detector. Finite, strictly positive, valid adjacent detected-bout frames are log-transformed; other frames are excluded before taking the median within each left-inclusive, right-exclusive 0.5 s bin. The baseline is the median of finite bin medians over [−15, 0) s, with one vote per bin. For bin deviation d from that baseline, the displayed value is 0.7d / max(−P10, P90), where the percentiles are computed from baseline-bin deviations using linear quantiles. At least 10 finite baseline bins and a noncollapsed baseline spread are required. Black cells indicate missing values, not zero activity. Colours saturate at ±1 without clipping the numerical values; 15 draft-E bins exceed the colour limits. Timing in F–H uses the established cadence reconstruction; no additional analytical smoothing is applied. Arrowheads in F mark the five Delay-fish trials shown in D/E (5, 13, 59, 62 and 89); horizontal boundaries separate session phases. These panels are descriptive examples and do not support population-level inference.

Displayed trial numbers in D–H exclude acquisition trials 1–4 (displayed trial = acquisition trial − 4). F–H therefore run from 1 to 90, and the D/E examples and marked F rows are 5, 13, 59, 62 and 89. Original acquisition IDs 9, 17, 63, 66 and 93 remain in the source mappings.

cards.title: F–H recipe Version 11 · direct log-bin medians
cards.difference: Direct medians of eligible log frames in 0.5 s bins; subtract median of finite baseline-bin medians [−15,0). One symmetric max(−P10,P90) denominator, without the 0.7 factor. 257/270 defined.
cards.notes: Historical recipe review. Original acquisition labels and saved annotations retained.
cards.legend: Bin-median-centred log vigor, symmetrically baseline-spread scaled. Original eligible log frames → median within each 0.5 s bin → subtract median of finite baseline bins [−15,0) → divide by max(−P10, P90) of the centred finite baseline bins. One positive denominator per trial, shared by reductions and increases. No repeated bout medians or bin means. Baseline median = 0. The wider P10/P90 side reaches its colour endpoint (−1 or +1); the narrower side stays nearer zero. Reciprocal proportional changes have equal opposite scaled values. No 0.7 headroom factor. Continuous blue–charcoal–amber, limits ±1; out-of-range colours saturate, numeric values remain unclipped. Dark charcoal is zero; black is missing. Each finite baseline bin has one vote; frames have one vote inside each bin. Equal colours describe change relative to each trial’s symmetric baseline-spread denominator; physical ratios can differ across trials. 257/270 scaled trials defined; 13 undefined. Minimum 10 finite baseline bins; no borrowing of scales. H trial 15: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (3 baseline bins); H trial 16: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (1 baseline bins); H trial 19: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (9 baseline bins); H trial 23: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (9 baseline bins); H trial 26: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (7 baseline bins); H trial 64: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (6 baseline bins); H trial 68: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (8 baseline bins); H trial 69: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (4 baseline bins); H trial 70: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (4 baseline bins); H trial 72: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (9 baseline bins); H trial 73: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (9 baseline bins); H trial 77: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (8 baseline bins); H trial 88: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (9 baseline bins) Compared with V7, this changes the underlying calculation to direct bin medians with a symmetric display scale replacing the separate-side Version 7 scaling. V1 uses complete-bout summaries; V2 uses direct bin means and symmetric scaling; V6 uses 1 s means and discrete percentiles; V8 changes saturation; V9/V10 discretize V7. V11 is a display adaptation of the handoff, not the frozen D/E B outcome: its baseline is estimated from bins. Timing and movement masks are preserved from the authenticated existing cache; timing uses camera-cadence reconstruction.

cards.title: F–H recipe Version 12 · frozen continuous bright blue–charcoal–red
cards.difference: Same direct log-bin medians, baseline and missingness as V11. Multiply the symmetric scaled values by 0.7 for response headroom; continuous bright blue–charcoal–red, limits ±1. 257/270 defined.
cards.notes: Accepted scoped scientific freeze.
cards.legend: Continuous diverging colours on the updated Version 11 values. Eligible log frames → median within each 0.5 s bin → subtract the median of finite baseline bins [−15,0) → multiply by 0.7 and divide by max(−P10,P90). One symmetric denominator per trial; wider baseline side at ±0.7, leaving response headroom to ±1; colours saturate beyond ±1, numeric values remain unclipped. Brighter sky blue #00bfff at −1 indicates reductions; dark charcoal #383842 (the established managua centre) at zero indicates baseline; brighter red #ff5252 at +1 indicates increases. Interpolate continuously in CIELAB through the three anchors, without solid bands. Bright blue and vivid red distinguish opposite directions; the dark managua centre is restored as explicitly requested. Black remains NaN. Colours close to zero approach dark charcoal; the 0.7 factor reduces saturation but values sufficiently far from baseline can still saturate; saturated endpoint colours indicate opposite directions. 257/270 trials defined; the same 13 sparse Control trials are missing. The physical bin values, baseline reference, eligibility and annotations match updated Version 11. Version 12 display values are 0.7 times Version 11’s values; the baseline-spread denominator is unchanged. Equal opposite scaled values are symmetric around zero; equal colours across trials describe baseline-relative spread rather than equal physical ratios. Author-frozen 9 October 2026, F/G/H only. Explicit freeze gate passed for 159 registered elements under specification 1.1.1. Final row width 183 mm; baseline median zero; wider baseline side ±0.7; colour limits ±1. Common fonts, strokes, protocol guide patterns and shared-axis label suppression applied at that scale. CS offset is dashed and expected US is dotted; strong CS width/opacity and the custom palette are scoped approved exceptions. Original scientific SVG, styled SVG, gate input/output and code/specification snapshots are embedded losslessly in this file. Older freezes and all other version images are preserved.

source.legend: Bin-median-centred log vigor, symmetrically baseline-spread scaled. Original eligible log frames → median within each 0.5 s bin → subtract median of finite baseline bins [−15,0) → divide by max(−P10, P90) of the centred finite baseline bins. One positive denominator per trial, shared by reductions and increases. No repeated bout medians or bin means. Baseline median = 0. The wider P10/P90 side reaches its colour endpoint (−1 or +1); the narrower side stays nearer zero. Reciprocal proportional changes have equal opposite scaled values. No 0.7 headroom factor. Continuous blue–charcoal–amber, limits ±1; out-of-range colours saturate, numeric values remain unclipped. Dark charcoal is zero; black is missing. Each finite baseline bin has one vote; frames have one vote inside each bin. Equal colours describe change relative to each trial’s symmetric baseline-spread denominator; physical ratios can differ across trials. 257/270 scaled trials defined; 13 undefined. Minimum 10 finite baseline bins; no borrowing of scales. H trial 15: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (3 baseline bins); H trial 16: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (1 baseline bins); H trial 19: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (9 baseline bins); H trial 23: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (9 baseline bins); H trial 26: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (7 baseline bins); H trial 64: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (6 baseline bins); H trial 68: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (8 baseline bins); H trial 69: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (4 baseline bins); H trial 70: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (4 baseline bins); H trial 72: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (9 baseline bins); H trial 73: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (9 baseline bins); H trial 77: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (8 baseline bins); H trial 88: fewer than 10 finite baseline bins (9 baseline bins) Compared with V7, this changes the underlying calculation to direct bin medians with a symmetric display scale replacing the separate-side Version 7 scaling. V1 uses complete-bout summaries; V2 uses direct bin means and symmetric scaling; V6 uses 1 s means and discrete percentiles; V8 changes saturation; V9/V10 discretize V7. V11 is a display adaptation of the handoff, not the frozen D/E B outcome: its baseline is estimated from bins. Timing and movement masks are preserved from the authenticated existing cache; timing uses camera-cadence reconstruction.

source.legend: Continuous diverging colours on the updated Version 11 values. Eligible log frames → median within each 0.5 s bin → subtract the median of finite baseline bins [−15,0) → multiply by 0.7 and divide by max(−P10,P90). One symmetric denominator per trial; wider baseline side at ±0.7, leaving response headroom to ±1; colours saturate beyond ±1, numeric values remain unclipped. Brighter sky blue #00bfff at −1 indicates reductions; dark charcoal #383842 (the established managua centre) at zero indicates baseline; brighter red #ff5252 at +1 indicates increases. Interpolate continuously in CIELAB through the three anchors, without solid bands. Bright blue and vivid red distinguish opposite directions; the dark managua centre is restored as explicitly requested. Black remains NaN. Colours close to zero approach dark charcoal; the 0.7 factor reduces saturation but values sufficiently far from baseline can still saturate; saturated endpoint colours indicate opposite directions. 257/270 trials defined; the same 13 sparse Control trials are missing. The physical bin values, baseline reference, eligibility and annotations match updated Version 11. Version 12 display values are 0.7 times Version 11’s values; the baseline-spread denominator is unchanged. Equal opposite scaled values are symmetric around zero; equal colours across trials describe baseline-relative spread rather than equal physical ratios. Author-frozen 9 October 2026, F/G/H only. Common fonts, strokes, protocol guide patterns and shared-axis label suppression applied at that scale. CS offset is dashed and expected US is dotted; strong CS width/opacity and the custom palette are scoped approved exceptions. source.legend:
(F–H) Example heatmaps for Delay (20221115_07), 3 s Trace (20230310_08) and Control (20221115_09). Vigor is calculated from distal angular speed using the specified movement detector. Finite, strictly positive, valid adjacent detected-bout frames are log-transformed; other frames are excluded before taking the median within each left-inclusive, right-exclusive 0.5 s bin. The baseline is the median of finite bin medians over [−15, 0) s, with one vote per bin. For bin deviation d from that baseline, the displayed value is 0.7d / max(−P10, P90), where the percentiles are computed from baseline-bin deviations using linear quantiles. At least 10 finite baseline bins and a noncollapsed baseline spread are required. Black cells indicate missing values, not zero activity. Colours saturate at ±1 without clipping the numerical values; 15 draft-E bins exceed the colour limits. Timing in F–H uses the established cadence reconstruction; no additional analytical smoothing is applied. Arrowheads in F mark the five Delay-fish trials shown in D/E (5, 13, 59, 62 and 89); horizontal boundaries separate session phases. These panels are descriptive examples and do not support population-level inference.

Displayed trial numbers in D–H exclude acquisition trials 1–4 (displayed trial = acquisition trial − 4). F–H therefore run from 1 to 90, and the D/E examples and marked F rows are 5, 13, 59, 62 and 89. Original acquisition IDs 9, 17, 63, 66 and 93 remain in the source mappings.
